iYagGJLOKILWUyPLF6VKWi.title: Counter refit
iYagGJLOKILWUyPLF6VKWi.content: Linnhe Joinery quote £4,860 for the ticket office counter with a lowered section. They can start in the week of 11 January if the counter is cleared the Friday before.

YmEUSMX5EiUJbKrc3bPhqz.title: Ronsay waiting room heater
YmEUSMX5EiUJbKrc3bPhqz.content: Heater tripping again. Corran Heating coming over on the morning boat on 2 December with a new thermostat. Lachlan to meet them.

rUzTP53NwHK889j84HSAhC.title: Jacket order
rUzTP53NwHK889j84HSAhC.content: 38 sizes in. Mull & Sound need the order by 11 December for delivery before the new year.

MHfiiw0P3pnH18HgtD9SRx.title: Café prices
MHfiiw0P3pnH18HgtD9SRx.content: Aileen keeps the winter menu prices until the spring review. Skerry are holding their coffee price for 2027.

mpogGcLTnhFhtdz098fD0H.title: Broadband upgrade
mpogGcLTnhFhtdz098fD0H.content: Northlight engineer needs access to the comms cupboard on 15 December, 9 to 12. Ewan will be in.

tfZt3O4n04xKVFyETDfogd.title: Lost property clear-out
tfZt3O4n04xKVFyETDfogd.content: Items older than three months go to the Ronsay charity shop on 14 December. Keep the phones and bank cards for the police.

DAzQMU7rgd0OGWUJdlSJ01.content: Proof 2 is fine apart from the café hours on page 3. Ottilie to send final sign-off to Harbourside by 11 December.
